title: Our Rights and Responsibilities
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: A child who says a right is not met at home (no food, being beaten, not allowed to school) is listened to privately and the safeguarding policy followed. Never ask a child in class whose rights are not met.

skills.key_step: The child names child rights and responsibilities at home and school and tells one from the other.
representations: a short story about a child at home
steps: Say what a right is and what a responsibility is.
Match a right to a responsibility.
contexts: a child who cannot go to school

board.do: Point at the card "go to school".
Wait for the child to say rights.

misconceptions.ask: Is doing homework a right or a responsibility?
misconceptions.repair: A right is what I should get; a responsibility is what I should do. Sort cards with the two words.

listen_for: Yes, I have a right to toys
misconceptions.ask: Is getting a new toy every week a child's right?
misconceptions.repair: Link rights to needs: food, shelter, school, care, safety. Wants are not rights.
Say: play helps children grow and be healthy. Show the right to play on the chart.
List small responsibilities children already do. Praise them.

checks.question: Name a right of a child.
